title: Casa Mango: Remodeled Humble House with New Pool near Pristine Beaches
description: This renovated Tico house, featuring a new pool, is nestled on an expansive mixed-use lot spanning nearly 1/2 an Acre. The property is situated on Calle "Perro Loco" between Playa Negra and Playa Junquillal, just a short drive away from 7 stunning beaches and a 30-minute drive to the bustling Tamarindo. Upon entering through the gate, you are greeted by the lush beauty of Guanacaste's nature, with mature trees and fruit trees encircling the new pool and covered patio (20m2). The house itself boasts 80m2 of living space, comprising 3 bedrooms that open up to the kitchen and air-conditioned living room area. Additionally, there is a spacious bathroom and a laundry room adjacent to the kitchen. Recently remodeled, the property features a new roof, septic tank, flooring in the living area, as well as the new pool and terrace—making it move-in ready for you to embrace beachside living at an affordable price! The property is divided into two lots, presenting a fantastic opportunity for expansion with a second house or guest houses, given that both lots are mixed-use. The second lot currently has its private entrance and gate, featuring a "rancho" with a wood-fire kitchen area and a chicken coop as the backyard for the main house. There is also a sizable storage space situated near the pool area. Calle Perro Loco offers a peaceful neighborhood setting, serving as a convenient back road connecting Paraiso and Playa Negra. A short drive away, you'll find yourself at Playa Callejones, Playa Negra, and Playa Blanca, with further spectacular beaches like Playa Junquillal and Playa Avellanas within easy reach—perfect for surfers, tide pool enthusiasts, and beachcombers alike! With Liberia airport just a 1.5-hour drive away and Tamarindo's amenities a mere 30-minute drive, this location offers the best of both worlds—peaceful living within easy reach of all essentials for a convenient lifestyle by the beach.

title: Casa La Artista: Sleek Modern Retreat with Ocean & Mountain Views in Ojochal
description: Welcome to your dream home in the heart of Ojochal — a peaceful, vibrant community known for its natural beauty, friendly locals, and rich lifestyle amenities. Key Features: •3 Bedrooms | 3.5 Bathrooms – Each bedroom offers floor-to-ceiling windows with blackout blinds, built-ins, ensuite bathrooms, and A/C for ultimate comfort. The master suite includes a spacious walk-in closet. •Open Concept Living – Entertainers will love the expansive layout with large accordion doors that seamlessly open the home to multiple seating areas, a generous patio, and stunning views. •Gourmet Outdoor Kitchen – Perfect for hosting gatherings and enjoying Ojochal’s idyllic climate. •Infinity Sukabumi Tile Pool – Auto top-off system, variable speed pump, and separate infinity circuit. Swim with panoramic views of the ocean and mountains. ⸻ Luxury Meets Sustainability: •28 kWh Solar System – German technology providing efficient, eco-conscious power. •Private Water Supply – Dug and capped well tested for high-yield output, with large concrete tank ready for connection. •6-Stage Reverse Osmosis System – High-performance (75 GPH + tank) for clean, great-tasting water right from the kitchen. ⸻ Smart Comfort & Security: •Full Camera System & Alarm •Large Concrete-Surrounded Safe •Automated Lutron Landscape Lighting •Starlink High-Speed Internet •Built-in Bose Lifestyle 650 Sound System •7 Extractor Fans (300 CFM) for Optimal Airflow ⸻ Additional Highlights: •Home Gym with Cold Plunge •Imported Flexform Sofa from Italy •Spring-Free Trampoline for Kids •Lush Landscaping & Fully Fenced Yard with Additional Lower Plantel for Expansion •Solid Block Construction | Single-Level Design •Completed in 2025 – Fully Furnished and Move-in Ready ⸻ Location Perfection Nestled in a quiet neighborhood just minutes from all of Ojochal’s amenities – world-class dining, waterfalls, live music venues, community events, pickleball courts, and more. A truly unbeatable location for both peace and play. ⸻ This home isn’t just a place—it’s a lifestyle.
